question: How are eight-sided and seven-sided forms arranged in relation to directions?
premises: An eight-sided form is made as before
A seven-sided form is made in the round
The seven-sided form excludes its own direction
inference: The eight-sided form follows the earlier pattern, while the seven-sided form is made without its own direction.
uncertainties: svāṃ diśaṃ vinā may refer to omitting a specific quarter in layout
plain_english: The eight-sided form is as before, and in the round form it is seven-sided, without its own direction.
